items.q: What does it cost for a venue?
items.a: For venues, there's no setup cost — Grabbies covers the machine, installation, and all operations. For corporates, we offer a fixed monthly rental covering hardware, software, and full management.
Typically 100+ daily active users. We assess your space during a site visit and recommend the right machine and product mix.
7–14 business days from enquiry to a live machine. We manage everything — you just provide the space and a power point.

items.q: How much does a franchise cost?
items.a: Typically ₹3–5 lakhs for the machine and initial stock, with payback in 10–18 months. We walk you through detailed projections — no commitment required.

items.q: What products do the machines stock?
items.a: A curated mix tailored to each location — protein-heavy at gyms, beverages and snacks at offices, affordable essentials at campuses.
All machines accept UPI — PhonePe, GPay and Paytm — plus cards. Every transaction is logged in real time.
Yes. Our vending machines stay stocked and accept payments round the clock, including non-business hours, weekends and holidays.
We do. Full operations are managed by our team. Franchise partners get SOPs and direct support.

items.q: How do I get my brand stocked?
items.a: Email contact@grabbies.in with your product details and MRP. We respond within 48 hours.

items.q: Can I track sales and performance?
items.a: Yes — our IoT-connected machines offer a real-time dashboard to monitor sales, stock levels and machine performance from your phone or computer.
